create_minimax_config: create a MinimaxMessagesConfig instance to configure MiniMax Anthropic-compatible API access
get_minimax_api_key: get the MiniMax API key from environment variable or parameter fallback chain
get_minimax_api_base: get the MiniMax API base URL with international or China endpoint fallback
build_minimax_complete_url: build the complete MiniMax API URL by appending the v1/messages endpoint to a base URL
retrieve_minimax_provider: retrieve the custom LLM provider string 'minimax' from MinimaxMessagesConfig
